user.title: Connect to your Vestaboard
user.description: The Local API talks straight to the board on your network, with no cloud dependency and no rate limit, but needs an enablement token from Vestaboard. The Cloud API works immediately with a read/write token.

local.title: Local API
local.description: Enter your enablement token the first time; it is exchanged once for a permanent API key. If you already have the API key, enter that instead.

cloud.title: Cloud API
cloud.description: Create a read/write token in the Vestaboard developer console.

error.missing_credentials: Enter an enablement token or a local API key.

abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.

data.blend: How attention and content share the board

data_description.summary_template: Write n in curly braces where the count should go, as in the default.
data_description.blend: Alternate shows one thing that needs you, then one that does not. Attention first runs content only when nothing is pending.
data_description.board_colour: Neither API reports it, and it decides whether white or black tiles show against the flaps.
data_description.forecast_entity: Which weather entity to read the forecast from. The forecast card shows nothing without one.

list.title: Messages you type
list.description: One message per line, each one a whole boardful. Every line is checked against your {board} before it is saved, so you find out something does not fit while you can still reword it.

data_description.name: What to call this set. Only you see it.
data_description.colour: The hue of the band down the left edge. Content messages have no band, so a colour on one does nothing.
data_description.entries: One message per box, rotating in the order you write them. A | starts a new row on the board; two in a row leave a blank one.

todo.title: To-do list
todo.description: Every incomplete item on the list becomes a message. Tick one off and it leaves the board.

data_description.colour: The hue of the band down the left edge. Content messages have no band, so a colour on one does nothing.

declared.title: Messages from entities
declared.description: For wording that belongs next to whatever raises it. Any entity that is on and carries a 'message' attribute becomes a message for as long as it stays on, so a template sensor can hold its own text in YAML you can diff, and it adds and removes itself with no automation.

data_description.entity_id: Leave empty to watch every entity that declares a message.
data_description.tier: Used when an entity does not set a 'tier' attribute of its own.
data_description.colour: Used when an entity does not set a 'colour' attribute of its own.

pattern.title: Colours and patterns
pattern.description: Decorative fills for the board between messages. Each pattern you tick is one card in the content rotation. They drift once an hour, and Sun follows the time of day.

data_description.patterns: Rainbow, Stripes, Wash and Checkerboard walk through your colours; Confetti and Mosaic scatter them; Frame is a border; Sun ignores them and paints dawn, day, dusk and night.
data_description.hues: Leave empty for all six plus white or black, whichever shows on your board.

error.does_not_fit: One or more messages do not fit your board, even shortened.
error.invalid_character: That message uses a character the board cannot show, or a character code that does not exist. Colour chips are the codes 63 to 68, each wrapped in braces.

options.contrast: White or black, whichever shows on your board

options.critical: Critical - takes the whole board, ignores quiet hours
options.task: Task - shares the board, counts as attention
options.content: Content - the resting state of the board

options.attention_first: Attention first, content only when idle

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Put a message on the board's rotation. Calling this again with the same ID updates rather than duplicating.

item_id.name: ID
item_id.description: Your own identifier. Reuse it to update, and pass it to Remove item.

message.name: Message
message.description: A single board's worth of text.

tier.name: Tier
tier.description: How urgently this competes for the board.

colour.name: Colour
colour.description: The colour of this item's frame. Leave blank to use the source's colour.

expire_when.name: Expire when
expire_when.description: A template evaluated continuously. When it becomes true the item is removed, so you do not have to catch the moment it stops being relevant.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target every board.

remove_item.name: Remove item
remove_item.description: Take a message off the rotation.

item_id.name: ID
item_id.description: The ID you used when adding it.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target every board.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target every board.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description: Take the board now for a set time, then hand it back to the rotation.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the board.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Leave empty to target every board.

validate.name: Validate
validate.description: Check whether a message fits, and see how it will wrap, without writing to the board.

tier.name: Tier
tier.description: Check against this tier's chrome, the way a real card would be rendered. Leave blank to check the text alone, with no frame reserved.

colour.name: Colour
colour.description: The colour of the frame to check against. Only used together with tier.

entry_id.name: Board
entry_id.description: Which board's geometry to check against.
